events.name: Forever Forward
events.summary: Welcome to Pokémon GO: Forever Forward! In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.
events.summary_ms: Selamat datang ke Pokémon GO: Forever Forward! Season ialah tempoh yang membawakan event baru, debut Pokémon, dan kejutan bertema. Bila season bertukar, Pokémon berbeza akan muncul di kawasan anda dan menetas dari Telur. Pastikan anda meneroka sepanjang season ini.

events.name: LEGO Stores and Pokémon GO
events.summary: The Pokémon GO and LEGO Group partnership continues for Trainers in the US, UK, Poland, France, Germany, and Australia! Visit participating LEGO Store locations for raids, a LEGO-themed stamp rally, event stickers, and LEGO Pokémon SMART Play. The LEGO Stores and Pokémon GO event will take place from August 3, 2026 at 10 am to September 30, 2026 at 11 pm.
events.summary_ms: Kerjasama Pokémon GO dan LEGO Group diteruskan untuk Trainer di US, UK, Poland, Perancis, Jerman, dan Australia! Kunjungi kedai LEGO yang menyertai untuk raid, stamp rally bertema LEGO, sticker event, dan LEGO Pokémon SMART Play. Event LEGO Stores dan Pokémon GO akan berlangsung dari tarikh tersebut.

events.name: GO Pass: August
events.summary: The Lucky Trinket returns and Latias soars into GO Pass: August! The GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe for August will be available from August 4, 2026 at 10:00 am to September 8, 2026 at 10:00 am local time.
events.summary_ms: Lucky Trinket kembali dan Latias terbang masuk ke GO Pass: August! GO Pass dan GO Pass Deluxe untuk Ogos tersedia dari 4 Ogos 2026, 10:00 pagi hingga 8 September 2026, 10:00 pagi waktu tempatan.

events.name: Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) in Shadow Raids
events.summary: Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) will make its Shadow Raid debut in Pokémon GO! If you’re lucky you’ll be able to encounter Shiny Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme)! Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) will appear in five-star Shadow Raids every weekend from August 5 to September 8.
events.summary_ms: Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) bakal buat debut Shadow Raid dalam Pokémon GO! Kalau bernasib baik, anda boleh jumpa Shiny Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme)! Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) akan muncul dalam Shadow Raid 5 bintang setiap hujung minggu dari 5 Ogos hingga 8 September.

events.name: 10th Anniversary Celebration - Perfect Mewtwo Timed Research
events.summary: Every Trainer can celebrate 10 years of Pokémon GO with a special Mewtwo! The Perfect Mewtwo Timed Research will be available from August 12, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. PDT to September 6, 2026 at 11 pm local time.
events.summary_ms: Semua Trainer boleh sambut ulang tahun ke-10 Pokémon GO dengan Mewtwo istimewa! Timed Research Perfect Mewtwo akan tersedia dari 12 Ogos 2026, 4:00 petang PDT hingga 6 September 2026, 11 malam waktu tempatan.

events.name: Ultra Unlock: Water Festival
events.summary: Arrokuda and Cramorant splash into Pokémon GO during Ultra Unlock: Water Festival! The Ultra Unlock: Water Festival event will take place from August 18, 2026 at 10 am to August 24, 2026 at 8 pm local time.
events.summary_ms: Arrokuda dan Cramorant melompat masuk ke Pokémon GO semasa Ultra Unlock: Water Festival! Event Ultra Unlock: Water Festival akan berlangsung dari 18 Ogos 2026, 10 pagi hingga 24 Ogos 2026, 8 malam waktu tempatan.

events.name: Great League and Scroll Cup: Great League Edition | Forever Forward
events.summary: The Great League and Scroll Cup: Great League Edition will run from August 18, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. to August 25, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PT. Great League Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter. Scroll Cup: Great League Edition Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter. Only Water-, Fighting-, and Dark-type Pokémon are eligible. The following Pokémon will not be allowed.
events.summary_ms: Great League dan Scroll Cup: Great League Edition akan berjalan dari 18 Ogos 2026, 1:00 petang hingga 25 Ogos 2026, 1:00 petang PT. Pokémon Great League mesti CP 1,500 ke bawah. Scroll Cup: Great League Edition juga CP 1,500 ke bawah. Hanya Pokémon jenis Water, Fighting, dan lain-lain yang layak.

events.name: Lunala in 5-star Raid Battles
events.summary: Lunala will be in five-star raid battles from August 19, 2026 to August 25, 2026. Raid Hours There will also be a Raid Hour featuring Lunala from 6:00 pm to 7:00 pm local time on the following date: August 19
events.summary_ms: Lunala akan berada dalam raid 5 bintang dari 19 Ogos 2026 hingga 25 Ogos 2026. Ada juga Raid Hour featuring Lunala dari 6:00 petang hingga 7:00 petang waktu tempatan pada tarikh: 19 Ogos.

events.name: Mega Swampert in Mega Raids
events.summary: Mega Swampert will be in Mega Raids from August 19, 2026 at 6 am to August 25, 2026 at 10 pm local time.
events.summary_ms: Mega Swampert akan berada dalam Mega Raids dari 19 Ogos 2026, 6 pagi hingga 25 Ogos 2026, 10 malam waktu tempatan.

events.name: Dynamax Hitmontop during Max Monday
events.summary: These Dynamax Pokemon may appear in Max Battles throughout this season. Max Battles will be available from 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time on Mondays. Power Spots will refresh more frequently. Additional Power Spots will be active on Mondays compared to the rest of the week. Max Battles will rotate to feature different Dynamax Pokemon. On August 24, 2026 , the featured Dynamax Pokemon is Hitmontop .
events.summary_ms: Dynamax Pokemon ini mungkin muncul dalam Max Battles sepanjang season ini. Max Battles tersedia dari 6:00 pagi hingga 9:00 malam waktu tempatan pada hari Isnin. Power Spots akan refresh lebih kerap, dan lebih banyak Power Spots aktif pada hari Isnin berbanding hari lain. Max Battles akan berputar secara berkala.

events.name: PokémonXP & 2026 Worlds
events.summary: Celebrate PokémonXP and the 2026 Pokémon World Championships in Pokémon GO! The PokémonXP & 2026 Worlds event will take place from August 25, 2026 at 10 am to August 30, 2026 at 8 pm local time. PokémonXP: Tuesday, August 25, at 10:00 a.m. to Friday, August 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. local time. 2026 Pokémon World Championships: Friday, August 28, at 10:00 a.m. to Sunday, August 30, at 8:00 p.m. local time.
events.summary_ms: Sambut PokémonXP dan Kejohanan Dunia Pokémon 2026 dalam Pokémon GO! Event PokémonXP & 2026 Worlds akan berlangsung dari 25 Ogos 2026, 10 pagi hingga 30 Ogos 2026, 8 malam waktu tempatan. PokémonXP: Selasa, 25 Ogos, 10:00 pagi hingga Jumaat, 28 Ogos 2026, 10:00 pagi waktu tempatan. Bahagian 2026 Worlds turut disertakan.

events.name: Great League, Ultra League, and Master League | Forever Forward
events.summary: The Great League, Ultra League, and Master League will run from August 25, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. to September 1, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PT. Trainers will also receive 4× Stardust from win rewards (this does not include end-of-set rewards). Great League Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter. Ultra League Pokémon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter. Master League All Pokémon are eligible.
events.summary_ms: Great League, Ultra League, dan Master League akan berjalan dari 25 Ogos 2026, 1:00 petang hingga 1 September 2026, 1:00 petang PT. Trainer juga akan dapat 4× Stardust dari win rewards (tidak termasuk end-of-set rewards). Pokémon Great League mesti CP 1,500 ke bawah. Ultra League mesti CP 2,500 ke bawah.

events.summary_ms: Regirock, Regice, dan Registeel akan berada dalam raid 5 bintang dari 26 Ogos 2026 hingga 8 September 2026. Ada juga Raid Hour featuring mereka dari 6:00 petang hingga 7:00 petang waktu tempatan pada tarikh: 26 Ogos, 2 September, dan seterusnya.

events.name: Regirock, Regice, and Registeel Raid Hour
events.summary: A Raid Hour featuring Regirock, Regice, and Registeel is scheduled from 6 to 7 pm Local Time. During this hour there will be an increased number of 5-star Raids.
events.summary_ms: Raid Hour featuring Regirock, Regice, dan Registeel dijadualkan dari 6 hingga 7 petang waktu tempatan. Pada jam ini, bilangan Raid 5 bintang akan bertambah.

events.name: Mankey Spotlight Hour
events.summary: Pokémon Spotlight Hour will feature a different Pokémon and special bonus for one hour at 6:00 p.m. local time on Thursday. August 27 : The featured Pokémon is Mankey and the special bonus is 2× Catch Candy .
events.summary_ms: Jam Spotlight Pokémon akan menampilkan Pokémon dan bonus istimewa berbeza selama satu jam pada 6:00 petang waktu tempatan hari Khamis. 27 Ogos: Pokémon featured ialah Mankey dan bonus istimewanya 2× Catch Candy.

events.name: Twitch Drops for 2026 Pokémon World Championships
events.summary: Get codes for exclusive Timed Research, a Worlds Tee avatar item, and special Pikachu encounters by tuning in to the 2026 Pokémon World Championships and PokémonXP livestreams. Trainers can earn up to five Pokémon GO rewards across the official Pokémon GO broadcast, the Pokémon World Championships finals stream, official co-streamers, and the PokémonXP Pokémon GO panel. Here’s everything you can unlock.
events.summary_ms: Dapatkan kod untuk Timed Research eksklusif, avatar item Worlds Tee, dan encounter Pikachu istimewa dengan menonton livestream Kejohanan Dunia Pokémon 2026 dan PokémonXP. Trainer boleh peroleh sehingga lima ganjaran Pokémon GO sepanjang siaran rasmi.

events.name: Mega Ascension
events.summary: Signs of an extraordinary mega-powered week are beginning to appear. Join Mega Ascension to prepare for Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale with Mega Raids, Kalos first partner Pokémon, and GO Pass: Mega Finale! The Mega Ascension event will take place from August 31, 2026 at 10 am to September 4, 2026 at 11 pm local time.
events.summary_ms: Tanda-tanda minggu mega yang luar biasa mula muncul. Sertai Mega Ascension untuk bersedia ke Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale dengan Mega Raids, Pokémon partner pertama Kalos, dan GO Pass: Mega Finale! Event Mega Ascension akan berlangsung dari 31 Ogos 2026, 10 pagi hingga 4 September 2026.

Trainers will also receive 4× Stardust from win rewards (this does not include end-of-set rewards). Great League Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter. Ultra League Pokémon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter. Master League: Mega Edition No CP limit. Mega-Evolved Pokémon are allowed.
events.summary_ms: Great League, Ultra League, dan Master League: Mega Edition akan berjalan dari 1 September 2026, 1:00 petang hingga 8 September 2026, 1:00 petang PT. Trainer juga akan dapat 4× Stardust dari win rewards (tidak termasuk end-of-set rewards). Pokémon Great League mesti CP 1,500 ke bawah.

events.name: Regirock, Regice, and Registeel Raid Hour

events.summary_ms: Raid Hour featuring Regirock, Regice, dan Registeel dijadualkan dari 6 hingga 7 petang waktu tempatan. Pada jam ini, bilangan Raid 5 bintang akan bertambah.

events.name: Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale
events.summary: Rally with Trainers around the world for the mega conclusion of Pokémon GO Fest 2026! Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale brings rotating habitats, powerful Mega Raids, and Super Mega Raids featuring Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y. Prepare during the lead-up event Mega Ascension , then join this unticketed worldwide weekend finale. The Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale event will take place from September 5, 2026 at 10 am to September 6, 2026 at 6 pm local time.
events.summary_ms: Berkumpullah dengan Trainer seluruh dunia untuk kemuncak mega Pokémon GO Fest 2026! Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale membawakan habitat berputar, Mega Raids berkuasa, dan Super Mega Raids featuring Mega Mewtwo X dan Mega Mewtwo Y. Bersedia semasa event pendahulunya Mega Ascension, kemudian sertai kemuncak event ini.
